get.description: One document: its open draft (with `revision`, needed to save) and its live version.

put.description:
Save the draft (creates the document when new). Send the `revision` you loaded; if a colleague
saved meanwhile the answer is 409 and nothing is overwritten. Prices are refused (422 `cms_price`).

post.description:
Put the draft live. The website re-renders the affected pages within about a minute; the AI's
knowledge and the CRM product record follow automatically.
Take the document off the website (versions are kept; publish again to bring it back).

delete.description: Throw the open draft away (a document that was never published disappears with it).

get.description: Every version, newest first (each publish is kept).

schema.title: Response Versions V1 Cms Collections  Collection   Key  Versions Get

post.description: Copy an earlier version into the draft; publish it to go live again.
A 30-minute token that makes the website show drafts (Next.js draft mode).

get.description: The library, newest first (`kind` = image, video, application (PDF) or model (3D)).

schema.title: Response List Media V1 Cms Media Get

post.description:
Step 1: ask where to upload. PUT the file to `upload_url` with `headers`, then confirm. Accepted:
WebP, JPEG, PNG, AVIF, SVG (15 MB), MP4, WebM (300 MB), PDF (30 MB), GLB 3D models (50 MB).
Step 2: the browser's PUT succeeded; the file joins the library.
